DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そちらの掲示は外さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please do not take that notice down.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 字が分からないので、案内所へ紙を持って行って聞こうと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 読めない掲示を持参しようとした理由を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot read it, so I thought I would take the paper to the information desk and ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain why you intended to bring the unreadable notice with you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ほかの方にも必要な掲示です。貼ったまま、写真や内容でお問い合わせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Other people need that notice too. Please leave it posted and ask using a photo or its contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: すみません。まだ剥がしていません。端がめくれていて、下の一行が読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未剥離でめくれて読めない部分を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sorry. I have not peeled it off yet. The edge is curled up, and I cannot read the bottom line.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not removed it and point out the curled part you cannot read. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その状態もお知らせください。場所を特定できるよう、どの入口か分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell us about that condition too. Do you know which entrance it is, so we can locate it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 南側の小さい入口です。写真に入口の案内も入れて、掲示の状態を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入口と写真で場所を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The small entrance on the south side. I will include the entrance sign in the photo and explain the condition of the notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will identify the location using the entrance and photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。めくれた部分を直す作業は係員に任せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please leave fixing the curled part to the staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。掲示の意味と、端がめくれていることの二つを事務所へ話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 内容質問と掲示状態の報告を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will tell the office two things: my question about the notice's meaning and that its edge is curled up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate your question about the contents from reporting the notice's condition. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにお願いします。ここから事務所へは通路をまっすぐ進んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. To reach the office from here, go straight along the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。紙は残し、写真と場所をもとに確認してきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 掲示を残し事務所で照会すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will leave the paper here and ask using the photo and location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will leave the notice and ask at the office. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 掲示は担当が確認します。お気をつけてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12237-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staff member will check the notice. Please take care on your way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 終点です。一度お降りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the final stop. Please get off the train for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰りもこの列車に乗るので、席に座ったまま待っていてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帰りも同列車として車内待機を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am taking this train on the return trip too. May I stay in my seat and wait?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to wait inside because you intend to use the same train for the return journey. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 清掃と確認がありますので、一度ホームへ降りてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to clean and check the train, so please get off onto the platform first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。荷物だけ席に置いて、同じ所を取っておくのもだめですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 席取り用に荷物を残せないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I also cannot leave just my luggage on the seat to save the same spot, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that you cannot leave luggage to reserve a seat. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 荷物もすべてお持ちください。再び乗れるかは、次の運行表示をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please take all your luggage too. Check the next service display to find out whether you can board again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見た目が同じ車両でも、帰りの行き先とは限らないのですね。どの表示を見ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同車両と次の行先の違いを質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even if it is the same-looking train, it may not go to my return destination, right? Which display should I look at?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between the same train and its next destination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ホームの案内と列車の行き先表示です。乗車開始の案内までお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The platform information and the destination display on the train. Please wait until boarding is announced.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では一度降り、案内が出てから行き先を確認して乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 降車後に乗車開始と表示を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will get off first and check the destination once the announcement is made before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will get off and wait for the boarding announcement and display. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。座席の確保より、降車を先にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Getting off comes before securing a seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。忘れ物を確かめて降ります。帰りの券も降りてから確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物を確認し先に降車すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check for forgotten items and get off. I will also check my return ticket after getting off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check your belongings and get off first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 足元に気をつけてお降りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please watch your step as you get off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お呼びするまでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please wait until you are called.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さっき渡した用紙の電話番号が違いました。新しく書いた紙と黙って交換してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受付済み用紙の誤記と差替え希望を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The phone number on the form I handed in earlier was wrong. May I silently exchange it with a new sheet I filled out?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report an error on an accepted form and ask to replace it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付済みの用紙をお客様だけで差し替えないでください。訂正箇所を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not replace an accepted form by yourself. I will tell the staff member what needs correcting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最後の一桁です。ほかは同じですが、もう確認が始まっているか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 誤った一桁と進行状況の不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The last digit. Everything else is the same, but I do not know whether they have already started checking it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the wrong digit and that you do not know the processing status. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当に進行状況を確認します。新しい用紙もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the progress with the staff member. Do you also have the new form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。こちらです。二つの申請を出したのでなく、電話番号だけ直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新用紙は二件目でなく訂正用だと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, here it is. I am not submitting two applications; I only want to correct the phone number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Make clear that the new form is for a correction, not a second case. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その旨を伝えます。差し替えか訂正かは担当が確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell them. The staff member will check and explain whether to replace the form or correct it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。古い方が残る場合にも、連絡先が二つあるように見えないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧番号が別連絡先にならないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Even if the old form remains, I do not want it to appear that there are two contact numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask that the old number not be treated as another contact number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 採用する連絡先を確認して記録します。新しい番号をもう一度読み上げてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will confirm and record which contact number to use. Please read the new number aloud once more.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この番号です。最後は八です。新しい方を連絡先として確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 採用する新番号を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is this number. The last digit is eight. Please confirm the new one as my contact number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat the new number to be used. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ訂正を伝えました。処理方法の案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have told the staff member about the correction. Please wait for instructions on how it will be processed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約のお名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please give me the name on the appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 兄の名前です。兄は来られないので、同じ時間に私が診てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 兄の予約時間へ自分が来たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My older brother's name. He cannot come, so I would like to be seen at the same time instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you came for your brother's appointment time yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご予約はお兄様の検査ですね。ご自身の受診としてそのまま使えるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The booking is for your brother's test. You cannot simply use it as your own medical appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は検査ではなく、咳の相談です。兄の枠を空けない方がよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の用件は検査でなく咳の診察だと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to ask about a cough, not have a test. I thought it would be better not to leave my brother's slot unused.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that your reason for coming is a cough consultation rather than a test. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 検査と診察では準備も異なります。お兄様の取消しと、ご自身の受診を分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tests and consultations require different preparation too. We will check your brother's cancellation separately from your own visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。兄から取消しを伝えてよいとは頼まれています。私の受診は別に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 兄の取消連絡の了承と自身受診を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. My brother has authorized me to tell you he is canceling. I will ask about my own visit separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate permission to report your brother's cancellation from your own visit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取消しの受付方法を確認します。ご自身の症状が始まった時期も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check how to accept the cancellation. We will also ask when your own symptoms started.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 咳は昨日からです。兄の検査内容とは関係ありません。今日診察できるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の症状と希望する受診日を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The cough started yesterday. It has nothing to do with my brother's test. I would like to ask whether I can be seen today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State your symptoms and desired visit date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人の受診として担当へ確認します。受付できるかはこれからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check with the staff about a visit for you personally. We will now explain whether we can register you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。兄の予約へ自分の名前を上書きせず、二つを別々に扱ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約名を書換えず別処理を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. Please do not overwrite my brother's booking with my name; handle the two separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for separate processing without rewriting the booking name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。取消しと受診の担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check with the staff handling the cancellation and your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような防犯のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What crime-prevention matter would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 庭の物がなくなるので、入口にひもを張って相手を転ばせようと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 人を転ばせる防犯案を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Things keep disappearing from my garden, so I am thinking of stretching a cord across the entrance to trip the person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a crime-prevention idea that would trip someone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 人がけがをする仕掛けは設置しないでください。まず被害の状況を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not install anything that could injure someone. First, let me ask about what has happened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ張っていません。置いていた工具が二回見当たらなくなりましたが、誰が取ったかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未設置で工具の紛失と不明な相手を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not put it up yet. Tools I left there have gone missing twice, but I do not know who took them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that nothing has been installed, tools are missing, and the person is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。管理や保管の状況も確認します。ほかに使う方はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. We will also check how they are managed and stored. Does anyone else use them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族も使います。先に家族へ場所を変えたか聞かず、盗難だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族利用を未確認だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: My family uses them too. I assumed it was theft without first asking whether they had moved them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your family's use has not been checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できる事実を整理しましょう。危険な仕掛けではなく、保管方法の見直しもご相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us organize the facts we can confirm. Instead of a dangerous trap, you can also discuss reviewing how you store things.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。鍵のある場所に移す前に、見当たらない物と時期をまとめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 安全な保管と物品記録の整理を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Before moving them somewhere locked, I will list the missing items and when they disappeared.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Offer to organize safe storage and item records. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の配置も分かる範囲で記録してください。家族へ確認した結果は後で追加できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also record the current arrangement as far as you know. You can add the results of checking with your family later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。ひもは張らず、家族の使用状況と工具の記録を確認して相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 危険な設置をせず事実確認を進めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not put up the cord. I will check my family's use and the tool records and discuss the situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not install anything dangerous and will proceed with checking the facts. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で伺います。見当たらない物を順に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will hear it on that basis. Please tell me the missing items one by one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 内容申告を確認します。この価格の欄は何を記入しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: We will check the contents declaration. What did you enter in this value field?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三と書きました。靴下が三足なので、その数です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 価格欄へ数量を書いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote three. There are three pairs of socks, so it is the quantity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you wrote the quantity in the value field. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここは数量でなく価格の欄です。数量はこちらへ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This field is for the value, not quantity. Please write the quantity here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: なるほど。贈り物でも、価格を記入する必要があるのか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 贈り物の価格申告について質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. I want to check whether a value must be declared even for a gift.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about declaring the value of a gift. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 申告に必要な内容をご案内します。購入価格など、根拠の分かる金額は確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will explain the required declaration details. Can you confirm an amount with a known basis, such as the purchase price?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: レシートがあります。三足まとめた価格ですが、一足の価格として書いてしまわないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 合計価格の根拠を示し単価との混同を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a receipt. It is the price for all three pairs together, and I want to avoid writing it as the price per pair.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the basis of the total price and avoid confusing it with the unit price. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 数量、合計の金額、通貨の欄を区別してご確認ください。表示に合わせて記入しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please distinguish the fields for quantity, total value, and currency. Let us fill them in according to the labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。通貨は円です。数量三足と、レシートの合計金額を別々に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 数量と金額と通貨を分けて記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. The currency is yen. I will enter three pairs for quantity and the total amount on the receipt separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Enter quantity, value, and currency separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書き直した後、ほかの品も同じように確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After rewriting it, please check any other items in the same way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ほかは入っていません。三足の靴下だけで、数量と金額を直しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 中身の範囲と訂正完了を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: There is nothing else inside. It is only three pairs of socks, and I have corrected the quantity and value.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the scope of the contents and completion of the correction. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 記入欄を確認します。元の記載と混ざらないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the fields. Let us make sure the original entries do not get mixed with the corrected ones.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所変更のご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss an address change, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今後の郵便を兄の家へ送ってほしいです。受け取りやすいので、口座の名前も兄にしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 郵送先変更と名義変更を結び付けた疑問を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want future mail sent to my older brother's home. Since it is easier to receive there, should I also change the account name to my brother's?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask a question linking the mailing-address change with changing the account holder's name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 郵送先と口座名義は別です。ご本人の口座を、お兄様の名義へ書き換える手続きではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The mailing address and account holder are separate. This is not a procedure to rewrite your account in your brother's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。口座は自分のままです。今も住んでいる所と、郵便を受けたい所が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人名義維持と住所の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. The account remains mine. Where I currently live is different from where I want to receive mail.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the account remains in your name and the addresses differ. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 居住先と郵送先を分けて確認する必要があります。希望の取扱いができるか担当が調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We need to check the residential and mailing addresses separately. The staff member will investigate whether your request can be accommodated.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。兄の家を自分の現住所として書くつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 兄宅を現住所と書かないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I do not intend to write my brother's home as my current residence.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not list your brother's home as your current address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点を記録します。お兄様には郵便を受け取ることについて確認していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record that. Have you checked with your brother about receiving the mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、相談しました。ただ、その了承だけで銀行の登録もできるとは考えず、条件を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族の了承と銀行条件を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I discussed it with him. But I will not assume his agreement alone means the bank can register it; I will ask about the conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish family agreement from the bank's conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ引き継ぎます。登録の可否を確認するまでは変更していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass this to the staff member. No change has been made while we check whether registration is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 承知しました。現住所は正確に伝え、郵送先だけ別にできるか相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 登録前に郵送先のみの可否を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will give my current address accurately and ask whether only the mailing address can be separate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask before registration whether only the mailing address may differ. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では現在の登録とご希望を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then the staff member will check the current registration and your request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: レシートの確認でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check your receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この短い名前の商品は買った覚えがありません。知らない物を請求されたと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未知の略記商品が請求された疑いを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not remember buying this item with the short name. I thought I had been charged for something I do not recognize.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Express concern that you were charged for an unfamiliar abbreviated item. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 購入された商品と一つずつ照合しましょう。袋の中を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us compare it with your purchases one by one. May I see inside your bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。このパンと果物と牛乳です。短い名前が何を指すか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現物を示し略称の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. There are this bread, fruit, and milk. I do not know what the short name refers to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the actual items and ask what the abbreviation means. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは牛乳の略記です。金額と数量も確認しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is an abbreviation for the milk. Let us check the amount and quantity too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名称だけの違いだったのですね。ただ、牛乳の数量が二になっているように見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名称確認後に数量表示の疑問を出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: So it was just a difference in the name. But it looks as if the milk quantity says two.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After checking the name, ask about the quantity display. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その二は商品分類の表示です。数量欄はこちらで、一つになっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: That two is a product classification code. The quantity field is here and shows one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。数字がある所を全部個数と思っていました。合計も一つ分か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 分類番号と個数の違いを確かめ金額も照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I thought every place with a number showed the quantity. I also want to check whether the total is for one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the difference between a classification code and quantity, and compare the amount too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。こちらの金額が一つ分です。袋にも一つですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. This amount is for one. There is one in your bag too, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認できました。略称と分類番号を取り違えていたので、追加請求ではありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加請求でないと確認した結果を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have confirmed it. I confused the abbreviation and classification code, so it was not an extra charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State the result that you have confirmed there was no extra charge. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 照合できてよかったです。分からない表示はまたお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I am glad we could match it up. Please ask again about any display you do not understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの落ち葉を袋へ集めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please collect these fallen leaves into bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この草のかたまりも入れようとしましたが、小さい穴があります。何かの巣かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 巣の可能性がある草の塊を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was about to put this clump of grass in too, but it has a small hole. It might be some kind of nest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a clump of grass that might be a nest. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 触らずに置いてください。生き物がいるかは管理担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please leave it without touching it. The management staff will check whether anything is living there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ持ち上げていません。中は見えないので、棒で確かめない方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未接触で棒による確認を避けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not picked it up yet. I cannot see inside, so I should avoid checking with a stick, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have not touched it and will avoid checking with a stick. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。近づいたり穴へ物を入れたりしないでください。位置を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please do not approach it or put anything into the hole. Tell me its location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 低い植え込みの右側です。ほかの参加者が同じ所を片付けそうなので、知らせておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 位置と他参加者の作業リスクを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: To the right of the low shrubs. Other participants might clear the same spot, so I want to let them know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the location and the risk from other participants' work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 私から作業を止めるよう案内します。お客様は少し離れた所へ移ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell them to stop working there. Please move a little farther away.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。巣だと断定して写真を広めず、未確認の物として伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 巣と断定せず未確認情報として扱う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not spread photos declaring that it is a nest; I will describe it as something not yet identified.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Treat it as unconfirmed information without asserting that it is a nest. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お願いします。確認後に必要な作業をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. We will explain any necessary work after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ではその部分を残し、離れた落ち葉だけ集めます。担当の確認を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 該当部分を残し別区域へ移ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will leave that part alone and collect only leaves farther away. I will wait for the staff member's check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will leave that part and move to another area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そこは作業を止めました。ほかの区域をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12238-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have stopped work there. We will show you another area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方はお休みですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。高齢の父が寝ています。起こさずに、私が立たせて列車まで運べると思ったのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 眠る父を起こさず運ぼうとしたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My elderly father is asleep. I thought I could stand him up and carry him to the train without waking him.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you were going to move your sleeping father without waking him. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 無理に立たせず、まず声をかけて状態を確認してください。普段の移動で介助は必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not force him to stand. First, speak to him and check his condition. Does he normally need assistance moving around?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 普段は歩けます。今は眠っているだけだと思いますが、まだ返事を確かめていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 普段の歩行と現在の反応未確認を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: He can normally walk. I think he is only asleep now, but I have not checked whether he responds yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish his usual walking ability from his currently unconfirmed responsiveness. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 安全な席で確認しましょう。反応がいつもと違う場合は、移動より先に係員へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check while he is safely seated. If his response differs from usual, tell the staff before moving him.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。乗る列車を急ぐより、父に声をかけます。ここで少し待ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 列車より状態確認を優先し待機を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Rather than hurry for the train, I will speak to my father. May we wait here a little?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Prioritize checking his condition over catching the train and ask to wait. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路を空けてお待ちいただけます。状態を見て、ご自身だけで運ぼうとしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may wait while keeping the passage clear. Check his condition and do not try to carry him on your own.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 父が起きて返事をしました。まだ足元が不安なので、次の列車に変えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 覚醒後の不安を伝え乗車変更を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: My father woke up and answered. I am still concerned about his steadiness on his feet, so I would like to switch to the next train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your concern after he wakes and ask to change trains. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗車予定の変更と介助の相談をしましょう。お持ちの券も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us discuss changing your travel plan and assistance. We will also check your ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。父が自分で歩けるか確かめ、必要な案内を受けてから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 歩行状態と介助方法の確認後に乗ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will check whether my father can walk on his own and receive the necessary guidance before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will board after checking his walking condition and assistance arrangements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらで確認します。急がずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12239-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check here. Please wait without rushing.
